metadata.title: Rigidity and Non-existence Results of $λ$-Translating Solitons
metadata.abstract: A $\lambda$-translating soliton is a hypersurface in $\mathbb{R}^{n+1}$ satisfying $H=\langle \mathbf{T},\nu\rangle+\lambda$; equivalently, it has constant weighted mean curvature with respect to the log-linear density $e^{\langle T,X\rangle}$, and is an eternal solution of the mean curvature flow with a constant forcing term. In this paper, we first prove that every complete properly immersed $\lambda$-translating soliton with $\lambda>0$ and $\inf_{\Sigma}H>\lambda$ has at least exponential volume growth, in contrast with the linear growth of ordinary translating solitons. We then prove sharp non-existence results for graphic $\lambda$-translating solitons ($\lambda\geqslant 0$) with bounded gradient, and two rigidity theorems.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 对带常强迫项的 λ-平移孤立子证明指数体积增长、具有有界梯度图形的不存在性及刚性定理。
analysis.breakthrough: 显示 λ>0 且平均曲率有严格下界时，增长行为与普通平移孤立子显著不同。
analysis.limitations: 指数增长需完备、适当浸入和 inf H>λ；图形不存在性及刚性各有条件，不能合并成所有孤立子不存在。 数学分析仅依据摘要和评论，未审读完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索及命中核查记录；未见披露不代表未使用 AI。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 平均曲率流与非紧曲面刚性相关，值得优先核查假设。
